messages.subject: WC-00146 - Privileged advice note for the Board
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert, Grace,

Please find attached our privileged advice note on the Saxena grievance and the recommended exit strategy. In short, we recommend the Board authorise an opening settlement offer of £95,000 ex gratia with delegated authority to settle up to £140,000, alongside a separate independent technical review of the cure-cycle evidence (which we'd quarantine in the meantime). The note is privileged - please keep it to the Board.

Happy to attend the Board to talk it through.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0211
